note: Harr's night lighting plan. Data only: tools/gen-harr-lights.py reads this file and writes the `lights-*` groups of content/veloren-world-harr.json. Coordinates are blocks in the same frame as tools/gen-harr-works.py (the Plaza is 0,0; +x east, +y north). Veloren draws a StreetLamp, a Lantern and a LanternpostWoodLantern with glow 24 (a warm pool roughly 10 blocks across on the ground) and a Candle with glow 16 (a small pool about 5 blocks across); Window sprites emit no light themselves, so a 'lit window' is a Candle set on the floor just inside the window. Peaceful lighting only: lamps, lanterns and candles.

sites.note: Every finished building and public work gets one StreetLamp at its entrance (the signboard side) unless a light already stands within porch_radius of that spot.

windows.note: Lit windows: a Candle on the floor just inside a Window sprite, added to the LAST stage of the project (so it appears when the building is finished, and never before its walls). The first rule whose pattern matches a project id decides which share of its windows is lit (at most `cap`, at least `min`).

rules.why: homes: every window shows a lamp-lit room
towers and archives: half the windows, spread out

targets.note: The generator prints these and fails if a target is missed.
